                      "automatic" refers to a start being issued to the

requirements.condition: An implementation-specific automatic-start decision determines that a BGP peer connection should be restarted.
requirements.required_behavior: Issue a start to the BGP peer connection FSM.
requirements.why_checkable: The automatic restart decision can be traced to its emitted FSM event.

requirements.quote:
The AllowAutomaticStart attribute specifies that
                      this BGP connection supports automatic starting of
                      the BGP connection.
requirements.condition: The optional AllowAutomaticStart attribute is enabled for a BGP connection.
requirements.required_behavior: Support automatic starting of that BGP connection.
requirements.why_checkable: Attribute-controlled automatic startup support is observable in the FSM.

requirements.quote:
If the BGP implementation supports
                      AllowAutomaticStart, the peer may be repeatedly
                      restarted.  Three other options control the rate
                      at which the automatic restart occurs:
                      DampPeerOscillations, IdleHoldTime, and the
                      IdleHoldTimer.
requirements.required_behavior: The peer may be repeatedly restarted.
requirements.why_checkable: Repeated restart support and its optional rate-control settings can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
The DampPeerOscillations option specifies that the
                      implementation engages additional logic to damp
                      the oscillations of BGP peers in the face of
                      sequences of automatic start and automatic stop.
requirements.condition: The optional DampPeerOscillations option is enabled.
requirements.required_behavior: Engage additional logic to damp BGP peer oscillations in sequences of automatic starts and automatic stops.
requirements.why_checkable: The enabled attribute can be checked for activation of oscillation-damping logic.

requirements.quote:
IdleHoldTime specifies the length of time the BGP
                      peer is held in the Idle state prior to allowing
                      the next automatic restart.  The IdleHoldTimer is
requirements.condition: An automatic restart is governed by IdleHoldTime.
requirements.required_behavior: Hold the BGP peer in Idle for the length of time specified by IdleHoldTime before allowing the next automatic restart.
requirements.why_checkable: Restart timing can be compared with the configured IdleHoldTime.

requirements.condition: The optional AllowAutomaticStart attribute is represented.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent AllowAutomaticStart as TRUE or FALSE.
requirements.why_checkable: The configuration value domain is a concrete Boolean constraint.

requirements.quote:
Description: This BGP peer session optional attribute indicates
                      that the BGP connection allows "automatic"
                      stopping of the BGP connection.  An "automatic"
                      stop is defined as a stop under the control of
                      implementation-specific logic.  The
                      implementation-specific logic is outside the scope
                      of this specification.
requirements.condition: The optional AllowAutomaticStop attribute is enabled for a BGP connection.
requirements.required_behavior: Allow automatic stopping of the BGP connection under implementation-specific logic.
requirements.why_checkable: Attribute-controlled automatic stopping and its trigger can be inspected.

requirements.condition: The optional AllowAutomaticStop attribute is represented.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent AllowAutomaticStop as TRUE or FALSE.
requirements.why_checkable: The attribute has an explicit Boolean value domain.

requirements.quote:
Description: The DampPeerOscillations optional session
                      attribute indicates that the BGP connection is
                      using logic that damps BGP peer oscillations in
                      the Idle State.
requirements.condition: The optional DampPeerOscillations attribute is enabled.
requirements.required_behavior: Use logic that damps BGP peer oscillations in the Idle state.
requirements.why_checkable: The state in which configured oscillation damping acts can be inspected.

requirements.condition: The optional DampPeerOscillations attribute is represented.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent DampPeerOscillations as TRUE or FALSE.
requirements.why_checkable: The attribute has an explicit Boolean value domain.

requirements.quote:
Description: The IdleHoldTime is the value that is set in the
                      IdleHoldTimer.
requirements.required_behavior: Set IdleHoldTimer to the IdleHoldTime value.
requirements.why_checkable: Timer initialization can be compared with the associated attribute.

requirements.condition: The optional IdleHoldTime value is represented.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret IdleHoldTime as time in seconds.
requirements.why_checkable: The configuration unit and timer conversion can be checked.

requirements.quote:
Description: The IdleHoldTimer aids in controlling BGP peer
                      oscillation.  The IdleHoldTimer is used to keep
                      the BGP peer in Idle for a particular duration.
requirements.required_behavior: Use IdleHoldTimer to keep the BGP peer in Idle for its duration.
requirements.why_checkable: Peer state and timer expiration determine a concrete temporal check.

requirements.condition: The optional IdleHoldTimer value is represented.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret IdleHoldTimer as time in seconds.
requirements.why_checkable: The timer unit is explicitly specified.

requirements.quote:
Description: The BGP FSM optionally allows the acceptance of
                      BGP peer connections from neighbors that are not
                      pre-configured.  The
                      "AcceptConnectionsUnconfiguredPeers" optional
                      session attribute allows the FSM to support the
                      state transitions that allow the implementation to
                      accept or reject these unconfigured peers.
requirements.condition: The optional AcceptConnectionsUnconfiguredPeers attribute is supported.
requirements.required_behavior: The FSM may accept connections from neighbors that are not pre-configured; the attribute enables state transitions that allow acceptance or rejection of these peers.
requirements.why_checkable: An unconfigured inbound peer exercises the optional attribute-controlled transitions.

requirements.condition: The optional AcceptConnectionsUnconfiguredPeers attribute is represented.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent AcceptConnectionsUnconfiguredPeers as True or False.
requirements.why_checkable: The attribute has an explicit Boolean value domain.
